# Isaiah Chapter 27 -- The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

## Consensus Translation

*[Full consensus translation of all 13 verses]*

*Leviathan slain; pleasant vineyard (contrast ch.5); atonement; great trumpet; worship on Zion*

---

## SOPHIA's Council Notes

Isaiah chapter 27 (Deliverance of Israel) addresses leviathan slain; pleasant vineyard (contrast ch.5); atonement; great trumpet; worship on zion. The key verse — "In that day the LORD will thresh from the flowing Euphrates to the Brook of Egypt" — captures the chapter's central message. This chapter belongs to First Isaiah (chs. 1-39), focused on judgment and the Assyrian crisis.
